scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,addon -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run build:addon:watch --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint:styles --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=frontend && npm run lint:fix --workspace=backend && npm run lint:styles:fix --workspace=frontend
